instances = []
CI = ComplexIntervalField(128)
def cdiff(a, b):
    d = CI(a) - CI(b)
    return RI(d.real().abs() + d.imag().abs())
CB = ComplexBallField(128)
def bdiff(a, b):
    d = a - b
    return RI(d.real().abs()) + RI(d.imag().abs())
